name: Craftsman's Writ: Catseye Draught
summary: A transferable writ requests one Catseye Draught and gives details for delivery and payment. You need the writ in hand to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Written Request
sections.body: The faded note bears a customer's request for one Catseye Draught. It also gives a delivery place and payment details, and the writ can pass from one bearer to another. The exchange depends on the writ being with you when you deliver the requested item.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Catseye Draught.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the draught?
faq.answer: The note provides a delivery location, marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Does the note say how payment works?
faq.answer: The note includes information about payment.
